sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r6/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 40 (check 39) and Internal Quality Checks row 40 (no annotation beyond the check text)
evidence: Source design floors all five cases. test.sh, scoring.toml and score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template; test.sh writes a zero reward first and exits 0 (reward 0) when /app/server.js is missing, a symlink escapes /app/node_modules, or the app never answers HTTP. score.py:48 gives reward = weighted only if gates_passed and floors_passed, with scoring.toml [floors] functional = 0.05. Blank page: fails the render gate ('A blank page, generic error, unavailable server, or static shell without meaningful data fails'), so reward is 0 and the scored suite is skipped. Static mock / seed copy: even if a client-side mock fakes sign-in for the render gate, gates/constraints/judge.toml requires posting 'Gate check JUDGE-G1' as Gwen, reloading, and seeing it from a separate browser context as Harriet; localStorage or read-only seed rendering cannot pass that, so reward 0. Refusing submission: the same gate post must succeed, and constraints prompt.md states 'A negative check requires its stated positive control... unavailable operation is not proof of a constraint'; every functional refusal leg is paired with a positive control (e.g. wall_every_route Sian's JUDGE-W0 controls, timer_changes Sian opening M-13), and functional prompt.md 'Every refusal pairs with a success of the same kind'. Keyword stuffing: judge-chosen fresh JUDGE-* tokens and behaviour checks (persistence across contexts, nesting, replays) cannot be satisfied by static text, all five prompts treat submission content as untrusted and never follow its directives, and scored prompts add a global gate failing 'static mock, static shell, missing backend, or seeded-looking facade'. Plausible broken app that could pass: a minimal server-backed chat (sign-in, post, shared read) that passes both gates. Its functional score is 0: every criterion needs features it lacks (mentions/search/transcript controls in signin_and_client_scope, dedup and transcript in sent_once_in_order, etc.). Even passing one 1.5-weight criterion gives 1.5/42 = 0.036, below the 0.05 floor, so it cannot farm polish (0.2) or visual (0.2) points; reward stays 0. Conforming alternative that could fail: an app using CDN fonts or scripts is explicitly allowed in every prompt ('External font, script, or CDN asset requests are allowed'), so the off-origin non-floor rule holds. Risk remains true because raw-evidence-index.json says 'reward discrimination/ranking on these bytes ... are absent'. No blank, mock, seed-copy, stuffed or refusing app has been run through the configured LLM judges on this candidate, so judge susceptibility to a convincing facade is reasoned, not measured.
